description: This file contains utility functions for client-side (UI) validation, specifically functions to retrieve validation data for database fields based on table and module information. It includes functions to fetch field labels, data types, and validation rules from the database, which likely support validation in forms within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Main function to retrieve validation data for fields of a specified tab or module. If a tab ID is provided, it queries the database to get field labels, names, and data types; otherwise, it delegates to an older API.

methods.name: getDBValidationData_510
methods.description: Helper function to get validation data for specified tables and optional tab ID, with special handling for email tables. It constructs dynamic SQL queries to fetch field metadata, translates labels, and returns structured validation info.
